consumer: The map-view renderer/export path reads each nearby tile's terrain and furniture identity, asking 'what terrain/furniture string id actually occupies this tile so it can be shown?'
scope: A map region: the nearby export-window tiles around the center (per-tile terrain/furniture ground truth)
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_tiles (per tile) writes raw map::ter(p).id().str() and map::furn(p).id().str() into the snapshot JSON; these are unfiltered authoritative tile identities, not a remembered/colored/LOS-gated display proxy
divergence: A tile whose real map::ter(p) is t_pit (dug out) or whose map::furn(p) is f_table, but the export reports t_floor / f_null from a stale or wrong source -- the reported identity diverges from the engine's actual ground-truth terrain/furniture state
